lead_micro_lagged_alignment → lead_meso_component_lagged_alignment upward Individual lagged alignment between a fish's turn and its neighbors' prior turns is the elementary propagation event that defines component mean lagged alignment.

lead_micro_lagged_alignment → lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction upward Fish whose own heading changes align with previous neighbor changes help make component turns sign-matched, raising the component cascade fraction.

lead_micro_lagged_alignment → lead_meso_component_influence_variance upward Heterogeneity in individual lagged alignment indicates uneven leader-follower roles, which can increase variance of influence scores within a component.

lead_micro_lagged_alignment → lead_macro_school_lagged_alignment upward The school-level lagged alignment is the collective expression of many individual fish responding to prior neighbor turns; widespread micro alignment supports the macro value.

lead_micro_lagged_alignment → lead_macro_school_cascade_fraction upward If individual heading changes frequently match earlier neighbor changes, the overall sign-matched cascade fraction across the school can rise.
lead_micro_influence_score → lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction upward Influential fish can initiate heading changes that neighbors follow, increasing sign-matched cascades within a component.
lead_micro_influence_score → lead_meso_component_influence_variance upward Heterogeneous individual influence scores produce variance in influence among fish belonging to the same contact component.

lead_micro_influence_score → lead_macro_school_cascade_fraction upward Individual influence scores summarize who leads local turns, and aggregated leader effects can shape school-wide cascade fraction.

lead_meso_component_lagged_alignment → lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction intra_scale When current component heading changes align with prior neighbor heading changes, sign-matched cascades across the component become more likely.

lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction → lead_micro_lagged_alignment downward A component with many sign-matched cascades provides a stronger lagged turning context, plausibly increasing focal alignment with previous neighbor heading changes.

lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction → lead_micro_influence_score downward Cascade-rich components can amplify some individuals' turns, plausibly raising the run-level lagged influence score of a focal fish.
lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction → lead_meso_component_influence_variance intra_scale Cascades concentrated in some fish create heterogeneity in lagged influence across the component.

lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction → lead_macro_school_lagged_alignment upward When component turns propagate as signed cascades, individual turns become more consistent with prior neighbor changes, raising school-level lagged alignment.

lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction → lead_macro_school_cascade_fraction upward Components with many sign-matched cascade turns can collectively produce a higher whole-school fraction of fish matching the prior mean turn direction.

lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction → lead_macro_school_influence_variance upward Uneven cascade fractions across components imply unequal leader-follower influence, which can increase school-wide variance of influence scores.

lead_meso_component_influence_variance → lead_macro_school_cascade_fraction upward Components with heterogeneous influence can generate uneven turn propagation, affecting the school-wide cascade fraction.

lead_meso_component_influence_variance → lead_macro_school_influence_variance upward Variance in influence among component members contributes to the overall variance of influence scores across the school.

lead_macro_school_cascade_fraction → lead_meso_component_lagged_alignment downward A high global cascade fraction indicates widespread sign-matched heading changes, which can amplify local lagged alignment within components.

lead_macro_school_influence_variance → lead_micro_lagged_alignment downward When influence is highly variable school-wide, a focal fish's current turn is plausibly more or less aligned with earlier neighbor turns depending on its local leaders.

lead_macro_school_influence_variance → lead_micro_influence_score downward A wide school-level influence distribution implies that a focal fish's lagged influence score is shaped by uneven leader-follower dynamics.

lead_macro_school_influence_variance → lead_meso_component_lagged_alignment downward High variance in influence scores creates uneven leader-follower roles, plausibly altering component mean lagged heading-change alignment.

lead_macro_school_influence_variance → lead_meso_component_cascade_fraction downward A school-wide spread of influential individuals can produce more sign-matched turning sequences, plausibly raising component cascade fraction.

lead_macro_school_influence_variance → lead_meso_component_influence_variance downward Global heterogeneity in influence scores can concentrate or disperse leadership within components, plausibly changing component influence variance.
lead_macro_school_influence_variance → lead_macro_school_lagged_alignment intra_scale Heterogeneous influence can reduce average lagged alignment when followers receive conflicting leads.
lead_macro_school_influence_variance → lead_macro_school_cascade_fraction intra_scale Variance in influence changes how many fish follow a common turn sign, affecting cascade fraction.

For N_i(t-1), let m_i(t-1)=mean_{j in N_i(t-1)} Delta theta_j(t-1). Indicator=cos(Delta theta_i(t)-m_i(t-1)). Indicator=corr(x_t,y_t) over valid t in the run. Execution: {'2a815b4dfe4f47b8ac2416fac04456e5': {'status': 'not_executed', 'reason': 'explicit_generate_only'}}
